symptom: GNU tar returned exit code 2 because macOS archive ownership and extended-attribute metadata could not be applied on the migrated RunPod workspace.
diagnosis: The content files were extracted despite metadata warnings. Every declared payload file independently reproduced its local SHA-256. AppleDouble sidecars and ownership metadata are not scientific inputs and are not referenced by the frozen stage.
resolution: Accept only the individually hash-verified declared files. Do not use archive metadata as runtime or scientific evidence. Continue with the exact locked bootstrap after the minimum stabilization interval.
